content:
Grace Lin: Opening this thread to lock owners/actions after today's vendor cascade postmortem (cloud region instability -> model-registry auth thrash). Need clear deadlines and acceptance criteria.
Omar Farouk: I'll own the short-term auth fallback. Scope: edge-proxy cached token for up to 120s, health-probe that flips to cached when primary auth returns 5xx or times out. Will gate behind ff.edge_auth_fallback. Aim: PR + tests by EOD tomorrow.
Helena Ortiz: I'll take token-rotation policy and runbook. Proposal: rotate at 75% TTL, add a pre-rotation audit that flags keys below 20% lifetime under load. Draft runbook + KMS playbook by Thu, schedule staging dry-run Fri.
Priya Malhotra: I'll update vendor escalation contacts and SLA appendix. Requesting account team to surface escalation phone + second-level on-call. Target: by next Wed EOW.
Connor Bates: I'll implement monitoring and synthetic tests. Plan: alert model_registry.auth_fail_rate > 0.6% for 5m -> pager + trigger canary routing. Also create weekly Tue 03:00 UTC synthetic that simulates 2x normal QPS hitting registry and auth to catch regressions early. Will post alert IDs and synthetic job link. Target: next Tue.
Grace Lin: OpsBot, paste incident link and quick metrics?
OpsBot: Incident IR-2026-052 created: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-052. Impact ~1.2% of traffic, duration ~39m. Runbook seed: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/vendor-cascade-seed.
Omar Farouk: Implementation note: fallback must not permit privilege escalation. Edge-proxy will ensure cached token is scoped to non-admin endpoints only. Pseudocode: 
```
if auth_check(primary) == 200:
  forward()
elif endpoint_is_nonadmin() and cached_token_ok():
  forward_with_cached()
else:
  return_503()
```
Will include tests to assert RBAC.
Helena Ortiz: Runbook will include rollback steps, verification steps post-rotate, and a communications checklist. Dry-run will rotate a small subset of keys and validate client behavior.
Priya Malhotra: For vendor contacts, I'll also ask legal to review escalation language before we publish SLA appendix. Looping legal in today.
Connor Bates: For synthetic job, I'll add tracing correlation so we can link provider 5xx spikes to auth failures quickly. That should help with the recurring-patterns dashboard.
Grace Lin: Timelines recap: Omar PR by EOD tomorrow; Helena runbook + staging dry-run schedule by Thu/Fri; Priya vendor/SLA updates by next Wed; Connor monitoring + synthetic by next Tue. I'll assemble these in a single remediation tracker and run a short weekly 15-min sync (starting next Mon).
Omar Farouk: Quick question: do we want the cached-token TTL to be configurable per-customer?
Helena Ortiz: Let's keep it global for now to reduce complexity, but expose it in config for advanced tenants later. Document decision in runbook.
Connor Bates: I'll add an automated test that flips feature flag and runs synthetic to verify fallback behavior.
Priya Malhotra: Acceptance criteria: fallback merged behind flag + canary shows proper failover in controlled test; rotation runbook executed in staging dry-run; vendor SLA updated with escalation path; monitoring alerts firing correctly; and a drill scheduled post-closure.
Grace Lin: After all DONE we'll schedule a 90-minute drill with SRE, Core API, SDK, and Support to validate end-to-end failure + failover. Marking items in tracker now.
Omar Farouk: Posting initial PR link here when ready.
Helena Ortiz: Posting runbook link after internal review.
Connor Bates: Will drop alert IDs and synthetic job dashboard link when live.
Priya Malhotra: I'll update the vendor docs and ping account/legal.
Grace Lin: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread for short status updates only; move discussions to respective PRs/runbook pages. Closing the loop: please mark DONE in tracker and paste links here. :white_check_mark:
